video_title: The Work: How Noa Essengue recovered from shoulder surgery

quotes.speaker: Noa Essengue
quotes.summary_phrase: Noa Essengue on the immediate pressure to perform as an NBA rookie
quotes.excerpt: Coming in the NBA, you expect to play right away. That was way different.
quotes.quote: Coming in the NBA, you expect to play right away. That was way different. I dislocated my shoulder three years ago, and that happened again and again and again. Pretty much three years, I played with that pain in my shoulder.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Coming in the NBA, you expect to play right away. That was way different. I dislocated my shoulder three years ago, and that happened again and again and again. Pretty much three years, I played with that pain in my shoulder.

quotes.speaker: Austin Dufault
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Dufault on Noa Essengue's versatility and potential impact
quotes.excerpt: One thing we saw with Noa as far as his ability to make an impact is versatility.
quotes.quote: As a coaching staff, I think one thing we saw with Noa as far as his ability to make an impact when he steps on the floor is just his versatility. Prior to his injury, I think Noa showed a lot of flashes. We were really excited about what was going to happen. Offensively, he can do a lot of different things. He can shoot the ball, attack closeouts. The size that he brings, how long he is, athletic he is, he is able to cover a ton of ground.

quotes.speaker: Michael Orr
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Orr explains the surgical and physical therapy process for shoulder injuries
quotes.excerpt: Once you anchor it down, it has to heal. Your body has to adhere to it.
quotes.quote: Initially, so when the labrum with the kind of the gasket or cup around the shoulder that keeps everything intact, when it peels off or if it gets torn, they first have to kind of tack it back down. So they are using anchors and surgical technique to anchor that back down. Once you anchor it down, it has to heal. Your body has to adhere to it. So there is a period of less mobility that you have to keep the shoulder in a certain position, below shoulder height where you are not pulling on the structure that was just repaired.

quotes.speaker: Matt Voss
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Voss on Noa Essengue's emotional maturity and ability to regulate
quotes.excerpt: He can understand situations and emotionally regulate himself better than people of the same age.
quotes.quote: He can understand situations and emotionally regulate himself better than people of the same age. I think our entire medical staff did a tremendous job with Noa throughout the rehab process. I think he has a city that is waiting to see how he is going to contribute to our team.

quotes.speaker: Noa Essengue
quotes.summary_phrase: Noa Essengue on the 1% improvement mindset shared by teammates
quotes.excerpt: Joakim Noah, for example, always told me you only need to get better 1%.
quotes.quote: Joakim Noah, for example, always told me you only need to get better 1%. You can just be 0.1 every day, and as long as you keep getting better, that is the goal.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Joakim Noah, for example, always told me you only need to get better 1%. You can just be 0.1 every day, and as long as you keep getting better, that is the goal.
